what: The design site's index (R126, P1-D03b): its sections and, per entry, the date, bead and status. Statuses live here, not in the HTML: awaiting-review, accepted or changes-asked. Entries are the data-entry ids in poc/index.html; the Vehicles section is generated from vehicles/roster.json. Owner comments on an entry become bug beads that cite it.
feedback: Comment on an entry (which state, what to change). Each comment becomes a bug bead citing the entry's id and page; work never waits for a verdict (R126).
